 "rationale": "GBW≥270MHz into 0.5pF needs gm≈1.1-1.3mS, so about 80uA at gm/Id≈13-15. f3db≥5MHz caps Rout near 50k, so gain is about 50-60 (34-35dB). A single CS stage lands inside both limits, and L sets gds. Budget: 10u iref + 10u mirror + 80u main is about 180uW. The PMOS width is trimmed with the forward LUT model so Id_n(0.75V) equals Id_p at vout≈0.9V. That keeps the output mid-rail and leaves headroom for about 1.3V of swing."}

PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (80e-6, 50e-6, 95e-6),   # main branch current
    "Ln":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),          # input device L (sets gds_n)
    "Lp":     (0.7, 0.4, 1.5),          # load L (sets gds_p)
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),         # load / PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Imir":   (10e-6, 5e-6, 15e-6),     # mirror branch current
    "vout_t": (0.9, 0.75, 1.05),        # target output DC level
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1, Ln, Lp, Imir, vt = p["I1"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["Imir"], p["vout_t"]

    # --- M1: find gm/Id so that VGS = vin_dc at I1, vds = vout target
    lo, hi = 4.0, 26.0
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        o = lut.size("n", mid, Ln, I1, vds=vt)
        if o.vgs > vin:
            lo = mid          # need weaker inversion -> higher gm/Id
        else:
            hi = mid
    m1 = lut.size("n", 0.5 * (lo + hi), Ln, I1, vds=vt)

    # --- ibias NMOS diode and mirror to the PMOS diode
    m_ref = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.65)
    m_ref = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=m_ref.vgs)
    m_n4 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, Imir, vds=0.7)

    # --- PMOS diode (reference) and load
    mp3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Imir, vds=1.0)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Imir, vds=mp3.vgs)
    vsg = mp3.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I1, vds=vdd - vt)

    # Trim the load width so that I_p(vout_t) equals I_n(vin, vout_t) per the forward model
    W2 = m2.W
    try:
        In = lut.op("n", m1.W, Ln, vin, vt)["Id"]
        Ip = abs(lut.op("p", W2, Lp, vsg, vdd - vt)["Id"])
        if In > 0 and Ip > 0:
            W2 = W2 * abs(In) / Ip
    except Exception:
        pass
    W2 = max(0.42, min(W2, 5000.0))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, Lp, m=max(1, int(round(W2 / 10.0))))
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp3)
    n.dev("MN3", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_ref)
    n.dev("MN4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_n4)

    # --- predictions
    gds_t = m1.gds + m2.gds * (W2 / m2.W)
    ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd * (W2 / m2.W) + m1.cgd
    A = m1.gm / gds_t
    f3 = gds_t / (2 * PI * ctot)
    swing = (vdd - (vsg - mp3.vth) - 0.1) - (m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (iref + Imir + I1)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": A * f3, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vt, "swing": swing}
